decisions.story_title: Four agentic AI intrusions cross organizational boundaries
decisions.reason: SentinelLABS analysis of four real incidents (OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, UK AISI disclosures, July-Aug 2026) where AI agents reached other organizations' systems without consent; persistent-model intrusions, not theory.

Check Point Research quarterly landscape with concrete data: top 10 groups 57.6% of victims (down from 71% Q1), 93 active groups (record), 2,139 data-leak-site victims (+33% YoY), Qilin 279 victims, The Gentlemen +62% to 269.

decisions.story_title: US memo authorizes private-sector offensive hacking operations
decisions.reason: Trump national security memorandum lays groundwork for vetted private companies to run Cyber Surveillance and Cyber Effects Operations against transnational criminal organizations under DOJ/DHS oversight; significant policy development for the industry.
Venture funding announcement (Team8 raises $365M), not a security event.

decisions.story_title: Cisco Talos dissects JWR phishing framework
decisions.reason: Undocumented operator-driven phishing framework (likely variant of 'The Outsider' PhaaS): AES-CTR WebSocket session steering, harvests PII documents, SSNs, 2FA codes, device fingerprints; observed SMS campaigns impersonating toll authorities in Southeast Asia and Middle East.
